name: chereta
description: Chereta — Ethiopian tender and bidding platform (NestJS + Next.js + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @chereta/contracts && npm run build --workspace @chereta/api && npm run build --workspace @chereta/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @chereta/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @chereta/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @chereta/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @chereta/api && npm run lint --workspace @chereta/web
